title: Indeed Jobs Intelligence Pro Input
description: Pull Indeed with rich enrichment. Mix keywords, search URLs, direct job IDs, and company pages. Filter by date posted, job type, experience, remote, salary, and radius. 18 countries.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Position or keyword strings. Each runs an independent search and combines with locations. Leave blank if you are passing searchUrls or jobIds directly.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, states, postal codes, or country names. Each combines with each keyword (cartesian product). Leave blank for nationwide searches.

country.title: Country
country.description: Indeed regional domain. Affects which jobs are surfaced. 18 countries supported.

searchUrls.title: Direct search URLs (alternative input)
searchUrls.description: Paste any Indeed search URL. Filters and pagination are extracted automatically. Mix with keywords or use exclusively.

jobIds.title: Direct job IDs (jk parameter)
jobIds.description: Indeed job IDs from the jk= URL param. Skips the listing crawl entirely. Fastest input mode.

companyUrls.title: Indeed company pages
companyUrls.description: URLs to Indeed company pages (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/...). Pulls every job posted on that company page up to maxJobs.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Hard cap on jobs returned across all queries. Indeed paginates 15 jobs per page. Set 0 for everything Indeed exposes.

datePosted.title: Date posted
datePosted.description: Filter by recency. Maps to Indeed's fromage param.

minSalary.title: Minimum salary
minSalary.description: Minimum salary in the local currency. Indeed often estimates salaries when the employer does not list one.

radius.title: Search radius (miles)
radius.description: Distance from the location in miles. 0 means exact match. 25 is Indeed's default. Common values: 5, 10, 15, 25, 50, 100.

splitByCity.title: Split nationwide search into top cities
splitByCity.description: When you want lots of jobs from a country, Indeed caps each search at about 1000 results. Enable this to fan the search out across the country's top metro areas.

scrapeCompanyDetails.title: Scrape company details
scrapeCompanyDetails.description: Fetch each unique company's Indeed page and enrich rows with rating, total reviews, size band, industry, and founded year. Pushed as a separate dataset row per company.

extractSkills.title: Extract skills
extractSkills.description: Detect mentioned skills in the job description (200+ tech and business skills, multi language).

parseSalary.title: Parse salary into structured fields
parseSalary.description: Convert salary text into min, max, period, currency, and a normalized annual estimate. Distinguishes employer listed from Indeed estimated.

classifySeniority.title: Classify seniority tier
classifySeniority.description: Tag each job as intern, entry, mid, senior, lead, principal, staff, manager, director, vp, or c level based on title.

detectEasyApply.title: Detect Easy Apply
detectEasyApply.description: Flag jobs that use Indeed's one click Easy Apply (vs employer redirect).

detectRemoteHybrid.title: Detect remote and hybrid
detectRemoteHybrid.description: Parse the location field and description for remote, hybrid, or on site work signals. Sets a workMode field on every row.

followApplyRedirect.title: Follow apply redirect
followApplyRedirect.description: Resolve the final Apply URL by following Indeed's redirect chain. Returns the employer's external ATS URL when present. Adds latency.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip job IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows. Off by default so a repeated query returns its full result set. Turn it on to poll for new items only.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of pages processed in parallel. Three to five is safe. Higher values trigger Cloudflare challenges.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for Indeed at any meaningful volume. Datacenter is blocked within minutes.
